description: Implement draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 method handlers. Defines CalendarsBackend trait. Registers 18 methods across Calendar, CalendarEvent, CalendarEventNotification, ParticipantIdentity. Notable complexity: per-user calendar properties (isVisible, isSubscribed, shareWith), two-level recurrenceOverrides patch semantics, expandRecurrences in query, onDestroyRemoveEvents cascade, CalendarEvent/parse (feature-gated). Entry point: register_calendars_handlers. Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 + RFC 8984. Pattern: jmap-mail-server. Blocked by: jmap-calendars-types epic.
title: jmap-calendars-server: JMAP Calendars method handlers
